description: The program coordinator and program registry (D-069 CO1): programs as first-class objects, the decision function, the launch adapter and the program gate.

coordinator.actions.description: The action vocabulary of next(), in the order a run applies them.

coordinator.brief_defects_limit.description: Most known defects listed in a launch brief.

coordinator.event_assigned.description: The event type that means a unit was launched; the status view folds it.

coordinator.event_ended.description: The event type that means the unit session ended; the status view folds it.

coordinator.event_failed.description: The event type that means the unit session failed; the status view folds it.

coordinator.event_merged.description: The event type that means the PR merged; the status view folds it.

coordinator.event_opened.description: The event type that means the unit opened its PR; the status view folds it.

coordinator.event_ready.description: The event type that means the PR is ready; the status view folds it.

coordinator.goal_window_s.description: The trailing window the goal metrics are measured over (a day).

coordinator.lane_item.description: The work.assigned item of a launch; the attempt number keeps a relaunch a new event.

coordinator.launch_rate_window_s.description: Length of the launch-rate window, counted from work.assigned events.

coordinator.launcher_argv.description: The Claude Code cloud CLI and its flags; the brief is appended as the last argument.

coordinator.launcher_default.description: Launcher adapter used when none is named.

coordinator.launcher_session_pattern.description: What the CLI prints for the new session id.

coordinator.launcher_timeout_s.description: Seconds a launch command may run.

coordinator.max_sessions.description: Most unit sessions running at once on the account; no launch above it. 1 since D-281 (Daniel, 01/11 15:30 BRT: only the channel redesign runs, one piece at a time; 5 by D-277 before it); a lane is added again only by a new decision with the quota measured.

coordinator.metrics.description: The goal metrics the program gate can measure from pr.merged events.

coordinator.padrao_dir.description: Where the versioned Padrão folders live.

coordinator.padrao_manifest.description: The rule list of a Padrão version folder.

coordinator.padrao_version.description: The active Padrão version folder the brief renderer installs.

coordinator.plan_fence.description: The info string of the fenced block in plan.md that carries the graph.

coordinator.plan_file.description: The program file whose fenced data block is the PR graph.

coordinator.producer.description: Event producer name of the coordinator.

coordinator.program_files.description: The files every program folder holds, in stage order.

coordinator.program_schema.description: The schema of a plan.md data block.

coordinator.programs_dir.description: Where each program keeps brief.md, audit.md, plan.md and retro.md.

coordinator.queue_owner.description: D-277: the owner a program unit carries when no lane holds it (a lane closed by quota). The coordinator never launches such a unit; it waits, pending, until a decision gives it a lane.

coordinator.quota_headroom_percent.description: Quota remaining below which nothing launches; an unknown quota does not block.

coordinator.retro_heading.description: The heading whose section of a unit retro the program retro carries.

coordinator.retro_marker.description: The marker the program retro puts on lessons that propose a Padrão change.

coordinator.retro_section_lines.description: Most lines of one unit retro section carried into the program retro.

coordinator.retry_budget.description: Failed sessions of one unit after which the coordinator escalates instead of relaunching.

coordinator.router_by.description: The actor recorded when the coordinator asks the defect router for fix units.

coordinator.template_dir.description: The folder under coordinator.programs_dir that is the program template, not a program.

coordinator.unit_retro_path.description: Where a unit keeps its retro; {unit} is the unit id as written in plan.md.
